header: Name and value, in a description list
lead: Pairs in two to four columns, each with an optional note below. It uses a real description list, so the pairs stay intact when copied into a document.
note: If the answer is only yes or no, use the included checklist. It reads faster than a column of the same word.

rows.title: Columns
rows.text: Narrower screens show two columns, then one.

rows.title: Numerals
rows.text: Values line up on the decimal point, so they are easy to compare.
